instrumentation.method: Reversible process-local wrappers on RoomEngine.prototype.advance/broadcastSnapshot/flushEvents and JSON.stringify. A diagnostic-only resolve/load hook redirects canonical loopback imports to an alias of actual source, preserving its flush body, splice/decode/handlers and queueMicrotask schedule. Only a flush wrapper, per-channel enqueue provenance and channel binding are inserted in memory; no game source is written.
phaseDomains: Advance inclusive wall span: engine work plus synchronous publication. Advance entry phase owns the entire fixed-tick call, including an outcome tick.

Synchronous snapshot/event publication: packing, visibility/list/ship work, serialization and enqueue; in-advance and outside-advance spans remain separate. Simulation/other advance is advance minus in-advance publication.

Top-level native JSON.stringify spans inside those publication methods are child spans, not extra totals. Nested stringify calls are not double-counted. Client input JSON and error sends outside those methods are not exhaustively attributed.

Asynchronous original loopback flush: JSON.parse, snapshot decoder and handlers together. Per-packet provenance is captured at enqueue, not inferred from match state at callback completion. Mixed-phase or unsampled batches stay in an unallocated bucket.

First-start/last-finish windows cover gaps between sampled operations, including caller/scheduler work in between. They exclude leading/trailing caller work beyond those endpoints; outside-advance publication can overlap delivery if called reentrantly and must not be blindly summed.
